The truth is, the 2013 Corolla has so much to offer, it’d be a shame to keep it all under wraps.
Available Moonroof
When you’re at the wheel of Corolla, things always seem to be looking up.
Take the available moonroof, for example. It offers you an uplifting view of
not just the moon, but also the sun, the stars and the glimmering city.
Remote Keyless Entry System
Convenience is keyless. Corolla lets you lock and unlock its doors with
the touch of a button. And once you open the door, a warmly lit interior
welcomes you inside. The remote can also be used to pop open the trunk.
Even the alarm can be activated remotely.
You’ve Got the Power
With Corolla, every excursion is a power trip. For 2013, all Corolla models
offer power windows, power door locks and power outside mirrors as
standard equipment.
